caption: The drawing depicts a single brown ceramic pot, which is centrally placed on a plain, light-colored background. The pot has a rounded body that tapers slightly toward its base and features two small, rounded handles positioned symmetrically on either side near the top. The rim of the pot is thick and slightly flared. The surface of the pot is adorned with a decorative pattern in a darker shade of brown and some blue accents, consisting of arches and circular flower-like motifs, with a larger floral design in a central position beneath the rim. The overall color palette consists of various shades of brown, with darker tones used for shading and outlines, and a subtle incorporation of blue in the decorative elements. There is minimal detail outside the pot itself, and the background is left blank.
title: Stone Jar
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
